node.label: Trade & exports
node.summary: India's exports and imports, tariffs and trade deals.

facts.text: The **Indian Rice Exporters Federation** advised caution on West Asia cargoes; rice exports to the region are only about **10%** of pre-war levels.
facts.plain: The Indian Rice Exporters Federation advised caution on West Asia cargoes; rice exports to the region are only about 10% of pre-war levels.

facts.text: Fortnightly windfall review: export duty on **petrol cut to nil**; diesel export levy raised by ₹3 to **₹11.5/litre**, **ATF** to **₹11/litre**. The import duty exemption on **cotton** was extended to **31 Dec** (poor monsoon hit the crop).
facts.plain: Fortnightly windfall review: export duty on petrol cut to nil; diesel export levy raised by ₹3 to ₹11.5/litre, ATF to ₹11/litre. The import duty exemption on cotton was extended to 31 Dec (poor monsoon hit the crop).

facts.text: India's pharma exports rose **4.9%** to **$16.14 billion** in H1 FY27 (Pharmexcil). **NAFTA** (32.87% share) fell 2.05% to $5.30 bn; **Europe** (20.38%) rose 9.66%; ASEAN grew 21.54%.
